hero.body: J&A Automation designs, integrates, commissions and supports industrial control systems worldwide—from PLC, HMI and SCADA to robotics, electrical engineering, simulation, startup and troubleshooting.

intro.h2: One engineering partner from controls design to stable production.
intro.p1: We design, integrate, and commission industrial control systems. From PLC logic and robotics to electrical design and stable production, we are your single engineering partner.
intro.p2: From new systems and line upgrades through commissioning, troubleshooting and remote support, our team works across the full automation lifecycle with a practical focus on what needs to work on the factory floor.

capabilities.h2: Controls, robotics and engineering across the automation lifecycle.
capabilities.lead: Build new equipment, integrate production systems, or modernize installed controls with full-lifecycle engineering support.
capabilities.plcHmiScadaDesc: Control software for machines, lines and process systems—from sequencing and interlocks to alarms, recipes, diagnostics and supervisory integration.
capabilities.roboticsDesc: Robot programming, PLC/robot handshakes, cell coordination, interlocks, conveyors, production logic and line-level integration.
capabilities.simulationDesc: Validate layouts, process behavior, robot paths and control interfaces before or alongside field deployment.
capabilities.electricalControlsDesc: Electrical design, controls architecture, panel engineering, machine interfaces and multidisciplinary coordination from concept through handover.
capabilities.motionProcessDesc: VFD, servo, motion and closed-loop control for conveyors, filling systems, machines and industrial process equipment.
capabilities.commissioningDesc: FAT/SAT support, on-site integration, startup, ramp-up, troubleshooting and production stabilization.
capabilities.supportTrainingDesc: On-demand or contract technical support, remote diagnostics, modernization planning, equipment specification and PLC/HMI training.

projectExperience.lead: Proven controls engineering across automotive, food and beverage, process, and industrial manufacturing worldwide.

techEcosystem.h2: Multi-vendor controls experience for the systems already on your floor.
techEcosystem.lead: Industrial plants rarely run on one platform. J&A engineers work across established and modern control, robotics, HMI, motion and engineering ecosystems—supporting both new projects and installed equipment.

delivery.h2: Engineering that follows the project into production.
delivery.step1Desc: Define the production objective, installed equipment, interfaces, constraints, standards and acceptance criteria.
delivery.step2Desc: Develop controls, electrical design, simulation, sequences, interfaces and documentation around the real machine/process.
delivery.step3Desc: Test logic and integration assumptions before site work through reviews, simulation and FAT where applicable.
delivery.step4Desc: Integrate on site, resolve interface issues, execute startup/SAT activities and stabilize production behavior.
delivery.step5Desc: Provide targeted improvements, technical support, training and remote troubleshooting after handover.

remoteSupport.h2: When production has a controls problem, route it to an engineer.
remoteSupport.body: J&A provides technical support for PLC, HMI, robot and industrial-control issues on demand or under contract. Remote diagnosis can accelerate troubleshooting when the problem can be investigated through the installed controls environment; field support remains available when the work requires the plant floor.
remoteSupport.helper: Include the machine or line, PLC/robot platform, symptoms, location and urgency so the request can be routed quickly.

team.h2: Specialists across controls, robotics and project execution.
team.body: The team combines international project experience, project management, manufacturer training and practical work across automotive body shop, paint shop, assembly, stamping and powertrain environments.

aquarexTeaser.body: Aquarex is J&A Automation's solution for acid and caustic recycling applications. J&A combines the process solution with the automation, electrical and plant-integration work required to operate it as part of an industrial system.

about.h1: Automation engineers with field experience behind the code.
about.lead: J&A Automation was founded in 2008 by engineers with experience in multinational engineering environments and industrial automation projects. The company grew from PLC, robotics and electrical work into multidisciplinary controls engineering, simulation, commissioning, technical support and training.
about.storyH2: Built around the realities of production.
about.storyP1: Industrial projects are judged on the factory floor. Software has to work with electrical hardware, robots, drives, mechanics, operators, maintenance teams and production schedules. J&A's project history reflects that practical focus—from machine modifications and controls development to line integration, commissioning, ramp-up and ongoing support.
about.storyP2: Today the company serves manufacturers, OEMs and engineering teams across the United States, Brazil and international projects, combining field execution with remote controls support.
about.teamIntro: J&A brings together controls programmers, robot programmers, electrical and mechanical designers, planning specialists, site managers, installation teams and instructors so projects can be supported beyond a single engineering discipline.
about.internationalBody: J&A's published portfolio includes work in the United States, Brazil, Haiti, Paraguay, Mexico, Papua New Guinea and other international industrial environments. The company is positioned to support customers across the Americas, Europe and global project locations.
about.principle1Body: Many automation problems happen between systems. Treat the PLC, robot, drive, machine, field device and operator interface as one engineering problem.
about.principle2Body: Find sequence, interface and failure-mode problems before they consume commissioning time.
about.principle3Body: A project is not complete because the code compiles. It has to operate predictably under production conditions.
about.principle4Body: States, alarms and HMI information should help maintenance and operations understand what happened and what to do next.
about.closingH2: Need an automation team that can follow the project into the plant?
about.storyP3: Our philosophy is simple: engineering excellence drives reliability. We build code structures that are modular, robust, and designed for the real-world conditions of the factory floor.
about.modularEngineeringBody: We develop PLC and HMI codebases using object-oriented principles. Standardized Add-On Instructions (AOIs) ensure consistency, reduce debugging time, and make our systems scalable.
about.oemIndependentBody: While we have deep expertise in Rockwell, Siemens, and KUKA, we remain hardware-agnostic. We architect the best solution for your specific technical requirements and budget.
about.lifecycleSupportBody: Commissioning is not the end. We provide comprehensive documentation, operator training, and secure remote support infrastructure to ensure your line runs at peak OEE for decades.
about.joinTeamBody: We are always looking for talented PLC engineers, robotics specialists, and electrical designers to join our growing operations in the USA and Brazil.

aquarex.skidIntegrationBody: Plug-and-play logic blocks for common OEM skids.
aquarex.chemicalDosingBody: Precise closed-loop control of dosing pumps based on in-line sensor feedback.
aquarex.alarmManagementBody: ISA 18.2 compliant alarm structures for rapid troubleshooting.
